adaptation: Paper RF AP-energy control adapted to 5G cells; no Wi-Fi model or exact paper hyperparameter claim.

target_kpis.network_ap_power_w: minimize actual window AP joules divided by time, under the explicit opt-in system power model
target_kpis.urllc_unique_deadline_failure_events_per: report UE2 and UE6 separately; original 10 ms deadlines unchanged

actions: empty cells deep sleep and all occupied cells micro sleep
empty cells deep sleep and all occupied cells light sleep

measurement: One global counter-delta row after real consumer owner/ACK confirmation and a full cycle of settling; complete equal-phase cycles, all 3 AP joule counters and all 6 UE deliveries.
training: Balanced 24 measured global windows, six per action; cap 512, 32 depth-6 trees, safe JSON inference. Bad outcomes are retained; the larger cap supports long-run data and released 250-row checkpoints.
policy: Energy-first research objective with QoS fully reported; no capacity or SLA guarantee. Frozen inference does not update the artifact.
